description: Write to non-protected attributes of the target; enables SPN injection, logon-script, or shadow-cred style abuse.

telemetry.detail: Attribute write (servicePrincipalName, scriptPath, msDS-KeyCredentialLink) logged if DS-change auditing is enabled.
TGS request follows targeted-Kerberoast SPN injection - watch RC4 (0x17) tickets.
Adding an SPN to enable Kerberoast, or writing msDS-KeyCredentialLink, are the usual primitives; both are increasingly modelled by EDR/ITDR.

prerequisite_privilege: Write access to target object attributes
abuse_primitive: Targeted Kerberoast (write then clear servicePrincipalName), or AddKeyCredentialLink, or logon-script write.
notes: Slightly quieter than GenericAll because it avoids password resets. Targeted single-SPN roast is hard to distinguish from normal TGS volume.
